versions.changelog: MC-021: Hallucinated Package Reference (CRITICAL) - flags npx/bunx/dlx executing unverified packages. MC-025: HTML Comment Injection (CRITICAL) - detects executable commands hidden in HTML comments. MC-026: Unsafe Package Install (HIGH) - flags npm/yarn/pnpm install without --ignore-scripts. MC-027: Insecure Bind Address (HIGH) - catches 0.0.0.0 binding that exposes agents to public internet. All backed by real-world incidents from BitsecAI and SecurityScorecard STRIKE reports.

- Added _meta.json metadata file for improved skill definition and compatibility.
- No changes to code or documentation content.
Fix: rules.json path resolution when installed from ClawHub (flattened directory structure)
Initial release: 20 detection rules, local-first skill scanning, no dependencies
